user.title: HDMI CEC Bridge Setup
user.description: Select ESPHome CEC tap devices to include in this bridge.

configure_tap.title: Configure CEC Tap ({tap_number}/{tap_total})
configure_tap.description: Configure {device_name} as part of your CEC bridge.

data_description.role: Output = TV/projector side. Input = source device side.
data_description.catch_all_event: The ESPHome event this tap fires for all CEC messages.
data_description.esphome_service: The ESPHome service to call to send CEC frames.
data_description.tap_address: The CEC logical address the ESP32 tap uses (default 11 = 0x0B).
data_description.physical_address: Required for input taps. The source device's CEC physical address.
data_description.device_address: Optional. The source device's CEC logical address (e.g. 4 for playback device).

abort.no_devices_found: No ESPHome devices with HDMI CEC entities found. Ensure your CEC tap ESPHome devices are online and connected to Home Assistant.
abort.no_output_tap: At least one tap must be configured as an output (TV/projector side).
abort.no_input_tap: At least one tap must be configured as an input (source device side).
abort.already_configured: A CEC bridge with this name already exists.

error.no_devices_selected: Please select at least one device.

add_taps.title: Add CEC Taps
add_taps.description: Select new ESPHome CEC devices to add to the bridge.

remove_taps.title: Remove CEC Taps
remove_taps.description: Select taps to remove. Must keep at least one input and one output.

abort.no_new_devices: No new ESPHome CEC devices found.

error.need_input_and_output: Must keep at least one input and one output tap.
